title: Show File Extensions
name: show-file-extensions
description: Always show file extensions in File Explorer, so a file named "invoice.pdf.exe" can't disguise itself as a PDF.
deepDescription: By default Windows hides the extension of known file types, which means a program called "invoice.pdf.exe" appears in File Explorer as "invoice.pdf" with a PDF-looking icon. This is one of the oldest and most effective ways malware gets opened by mistake. This tweak sets HideFileExt to 0 so the real extension is always visible. File Explorer is restarted to apply the change.
modal: This makes File Explorer always show file extensions, so disguised files like "invoice.pdf.exe" can't hide what they really are. File Explorer will restart briefly.
